step1_figure.circuit_type: Folded-cascode op-amp with class AB output buffer
step1_figure.description: A folded-cascode operational amplifier utilizing a class AB output stage to improve drive capability and slew rate. It includes floating current sources for class AB control.

open_loop_gain.description: Low-frequency open-loop DC gain of the op-amp

equation.explanation: Product of the first stage (folded cascode) gain and the second stage (class AB push-pull) gain.
equation.assumptions: Assumes output resistance is dominated by the cascode and push-pull devices.

sky130_expected.calculation: First stage gain ~ 50-60 dB. Second stage gain ~ 20-30 dB. Total expected gain is the sum in dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on typical SKY130 intrinsic gains (gm*ro ~ 20-50) and the two-stage architecture.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Frequency at which the open-loop gain drops to 0 dB

equation.explanation: Gain-bandwidth product determined by the input transconductance and the compensation capacitor.
equation.assumptions: Assumes dominant pole compensation and negligible non-dominant poles at fun.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the exact bias current and input pair sizing in the parameterized netlist.

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage

equation.explanation: Rate at which the tail current can charge the compensation capacitor.
equation.assumptions: Assumes the first stage limits the slew rate, though the class AB stage can provide more current to the load.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Class AB output improves load slewing, but internal node slewing is limited by C_c.

phase_margin.description: Phase difference from -180 degrees at the unity-gain frequency

equation.explanation: Measures the stability of the closed-loop system.

sky130_expected.calculation: Targeted for >45 degrees for stability, typically around 60 degrees.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard design target for op-amps to ensure minimal ringing.

power_dissipation.description: Total DC power consumed by the op-amp and bias circuit

equation.explanation: Product of supply voltage and total supply current.
equation.assumptions: Measured in quiescent state (no input signal).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Consistent with the 140uA bias current mentioned in the text plus the amplifier core.

step3_testbench.description: Measures open-loop gain, unity-gain frequency, phase margin, slew rate, and power dissipation.
